'''Alexandru Cecal''' (July 18, 1940 – November 1, 2021) was a [[chemist]], professor at the [[Alexandru Ioan Cuza University]] of [[Iași]], Romania,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.chem.uaic.ro/|title=Facultatea de Chimie Iași|website=www.chem.uaic.ro}}</ref> known especially for his contributions in the field of [[radiochemistry]].

==Education==
Cecal was born in [[Cahul]], [[Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic|Moldavian SSR]] and attended the primary school in [[Pianu]], [[Alba County]] (1947–1951), continuing his studies (1951–1957)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5cPocKE1qsQ|title=Liceul de Băieți din Alba-Iulia, promoția 1957|author=|date=|website=[[YouTube]]|archive-url=|archive-date=}}</ref> at the Boys' Middle School<ref>{{cite web
|url=http://www.dacoromania-alba.ro/nr43/horea_closca_crisan.htm|access-date=24 April 2023|website=dacoromania-alba.ro|title=Biblioteca Colegiului Naţional "Horea, Cloşca şi Crişan", Alba Iulia|language=ro|author=Barbu Ştefãnescu Delavrancea}}</ref> (former Mihai Viteazul Theoretical High School, now [[Horea, Cloșca and Crișan National College]])<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.hcc.ro/|title=Colegiul National HCC Alba Iulia|website=www.hcc.ro}}</ref> from [[Alba Iulia]].

Between 1958 and 1963, he attended the [[University of Bucharest]] ([[Physical chemistry]]/[[Radiochemistry]]). In 1972 he gained his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in chemistry at the [[Alexandru Ioan Cuza University]] of [[Iași]], with a thesis entitled "Kinetics of the isotopic exchange reactions in Tl(I)–Tl(III) complexes with different ligands", written under the supervision of  {{ill|Hans Adam Schneider|ro}}. He fulfilled several postdoctoral appointments in universities and research centers such as [[Technical University of Munich]] (group of [[Hans-Joachim Born]]), [[TU Dresden]], [[Helmholtz Association of German Research Centres|Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe]], [[Moscow State University]] (group of [[Alexander Nesmeyanov]]), [[Laval University]], etc.
